shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other. A woman in an emerald green cardigan sits in the plant-side window seat telling a story, a man in a mustard yellow turtleneck sits in the counter-side window seat, and a woman in a navy blue jacket sits in the plant-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the counter end, looking lengthwise along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with the full table and all three seats in frame.

shots.content: The man in a mustard yellow turtleneck asks the woman in an emerald green cardigan for the outcome.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in an emerald green cardigan answers the man in a mustard yellow turtleneck.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the rectangular table, centered on the tabletop, with the full table and all three seats in frame.
